LanguageData.CC_HarmTwo_FrayedBand: A sharp word comes to blows more easily.
LanguageData.CC_HarmTwo_Frayed: {PAWN_nameDef} has been {BAND} for a while, and a sharp word with {OTHER_nameDef} came to blows.
LanguageData.CC_HarmTwo_Frayed_2: Days of strain have left {PAWN_nameDef} {BAND}, and this time the words with {OTHER_nameDef} ended in a fight.
LanguageData.CC_Impact_CampQuarrel: The quarrel may come to blows at their fire in the evenings, and if it does the camp packs up early
LanguageData.CC_Impact_CampQuarrelBrief: may come to blows at the camp
LanguageData.CC_HarmTwo_CampBrawl: Raised voices at the {NAME}'s fire turned into a brawl: {A_nameDef} and {X_nameDef} came to blows on the colony's land.
LanguageData.CC_HarmTwo_CampBrawl_2: The quarrel at the {NAME}'s fire boiled over, and {A_nameDef} and {X_nameDef} of the {FACTION} are fighting.
LanguageData.CC_HarmTwo_CampBrawlTheirs: The quarrel among the {NAME} came to blows at their fire: {X_nameDef} and {THING} are fighting.
LanguageData.CC_HarmTwo_CampBrawlTheirs_2: Raised voices at the {NAME}'s fire, and then fists: {X_nameDef} and {THING} of the {FACTION} have come to blows.
LanguageData.CC_HarmTwo_CampBrawlJoined: Others at the fire joined in: {WHO}.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_End_brawl: After the brawl at their fire, the {NAME} from {FACTION} packed up their camp {PLACE} early and left. Their people will remember it as a fistfight on the colony's land.
LanguageData.CC_HarmTwo_BoutForm_Medieval: a bout with quarterstaves and blunted swords
LanguageData.CC_Impact_ChampionBout: A bout on the map before the colony, and now and then a blow lands for real on {0} or the champion
LanguageData.CC_Impact_ChampionBoutBrief: a blow may land for real
LanguageData.CC_HarmTwo_ChampionBlow: One blow in the bout landed for real, and {HURT_nameDef} took it from {OTHER_nameDef}.
LanguageData.CC_HarmTwo_ChampionBlow_2: {HURT_nameDef} came out of the bout with {OTHER_nameDef} properly hurt by a blow that wasn't pulled.
LanguageData.CC_Impact_HuntTurn: The {KIND} among the game may turn on its hunters, as the game has it
LanguageData.CC_Impact_HuntTurnBrief: the {KIND} may turn on its hunters
LanguageData.CC_HarmTwo_HuntTurnNote: The {KIND} may turn on its hunters.
LanguageData.CC_HarmTwo_HuntTurnCalendar: A lone {KIND} is among the day's game, and it may turn on its hunters.
LanguageData.CC_HarmTwo_HuntTurned: The {KIND} {PAWN_nameDef} was hunting has turned on {PAWN_objective}.
LanguageData.CC_HarmTwo_HuntTurned_2: Hit but not down, the {KIND} has turned and is coming for {PAWN_nameDef}.
LanguageData.CC_HarmTwo_SickHome: {PAWN_nameDef} has fallen ill a few days after coming home from {TOWN}: {ILLNESS}. {WHY}
LanguageData.CC_HarmTwo_SickHome_2: {PAWN_nameDef} brought more than goods home from {TOWN}, and is ill with it now: {ILLNESS}. {WHY}
LanguageData.CC_HarmTwo_SickHome_Plague: A plague was going round {TOWN} while the caravan stayed there.
LanguageData.CC_HarmTwo_SickHome_Famine: {TOWN} was going hungry while the caravan stayed there, and the sickness that follows short rations and bad water was about.
LanguageData.CC_HarmTwo_Sabotage_What_Tribal: the charm {OTHER_nameDef} keeps on {OTHER_possessive} {BENCH} taken and {OTHER_possessive} tools knocked about
LanguageData.CC_HarmTwo_SabotageUnknown: Someone has been at {OTHER_nameDef}'s work: {WHAT}. Nobody saw who.
LanguageData.CC_HarmTwo_SabotageUnknown_2: {OTHER_nameDef} will find {OTHER_possessive} work spoiled: {WHAT}. Whoever did it wasn't seen.
LanguageData.CC_HarmTwo_SabotageFight: {OTHER_nameDef} found out who was behind {WHAT} ({HOW}), went to have it out with {PAWN_nameDef}, and it came to blows.
LanguageData.CC_HarmTwo_SabotageFight_2: It was {PAWN_nameDef} behind {WHAT}, and {HOW}. {OTHER_nameDef} has gone for {PAWN_objective}, fists first.
LanguageData.CC_HarmTwo_SabotageWords: {OTHER_nameDef} found out who was behind {WHAT} ({HOW}), and had hard words with {PAWN_nameDef} over it.
LanguageData.CC_HarmTwo_SabotageWords_2: It was {PAWN_nameDef} behind {WHAT}, and {HOW}. {OTHER_nameDef} said so to {PAWN_possessive} face.
LanguageData.CC_HarmTwo_HustingsBrawl: At the hustings, {PAWN_nameDef} heckled {SPEAKER_nameDef}, and {OTHER_nameDef}, an old rival backing {SPEAKER_nameDef}, answered with fists.
LanguageData.CC_HarmTwo_HustingsBrawl_2: A heckle at {SPEAKER_nameDef}'s speech went too far: {OTHER_nameDef} and {PAWN_nameDef} have come to blows in front of the hustings.
